description: Removal of existing ATM (Automated Telling Machine), associated signage and projecting sign and infilling of the wall void with matching bricks.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (6331/G1/E2 (Rev B)  Received:  10 July 2020
Draft Location Plan  Received:  11 June 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The external side wall void, caused by the removal of the bank's side ATM hereby approved, shall be infilled with red bricks and mortar to match the appearance of the existing side wall, including its texture, colour and bonding.
Condition : 4 - The existing branded projecting sign positioned above the existing side ATM shall be removed prior to the completion of the approved construction works.
